The vendor directly providing the **OpenSearch Project** at **opensearch.org** is **The Linux Foundation** (via the **OpenSearch Software Foundation** / **OpenSearch Project a Series of LF Projects, LLC**).

### Provider Statement & Evidence
According to the official site footer and policy notices across **opensearch.org**:
> *"© Copyright The Linux Foundation. The OpenSearch Project is a project of The Linux Foundation. ... The OpenSearch Project supports the OpenSearch open source project, which has been established as OpenSearch Project a Series of LF Projects, LLC."*

Additionally, the project's Terms of Service and governance documentation note that the initiative is organized under the Linux Foundation's **OpenSearch Software Foundation**.
